bio: Originally a stately apartment building overlooking Hyde Park and Marble Arch, the five-star London Marriott Hotel Park Lane is now a leading boutique hotel in Mayfair serving a stunning Botanical Afternoon Tea in its restaurant and bar, Lanes of London.  Inspired by London’s most recognisable icons, tasty finger sandwiches, delightful pastries and freshly baked scones adorn the menu, served on a modern, multi-tiered stand. Featuring a lavender white chocolate mousse handbag, a basil infused blackberry and yoghurt teapot and more. All to be enjoyed while sipping one of our carefully selected Jing teas, bubbles or house cocktails.  Just steps from the greenery of Hyde Park, the afternoon tea takes its botanical influence from English gardens and ingredients, offering a calming retreat from the hustle and bustle of Oxford Street.  Available Friday-Sunday from 12:00 to 4:00pm. Starting from £50 per person with a glass of bubbles.
